raw_output: Entry is on the first test of VWAP after price breaks into value on a trending day.
VWAP plays a better magnet than it does a trading level except in a trend.
After the test of VWAP, we enter on strength in the direction away from the VWAP.
A trending day or a high volatility day with price going in and out of value during its trend.
the stop goes above or below the testing candle at the VWAP
